snippet.title: Doomed Crew  - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Doomed Crew is a 1-4 player co-op horror experience. Step into the boots of death row inmates given a final choice of working under a brutal corporation. Complete given tasks, survive the horrors, get back in one piece, and hope to earn your promised freedom.

Wishlist On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119020/Doomed_Crew
